allow: Bash(mkdir -p /tmp/helm-cache && helm pull ping-devops --repo https://helm.pingidentity.com/ --version 0.12.2 --destination /tmp/helm-cache/ 2>&1 && ls /tmp/helm-cache/)

hooks.command: f=$(python3 -c "import json,os; print(json.loads(os.environ.get('CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT','{}')).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *api/v1alpha1/*_types.go) make manifests helm-sync-crds 2>&1;; esac
